questions.question: Ssenariy: pod `CrashLoopBackOff` da. Diagnostika qadamlaringiz?
questions.explanation: Holat va restart soni: kubectl get pod <name> -o wide.

questions.question: Ssenariy: pod `Exit Code 137` bilan tugadi. Nima bo'ldi va qanday tuzatasiz?
questions.explanation: Sabab: SIGKILL (128 + 9) — odatda xotira limits.memory dan oshgani uchun OOM killer (yoki grace period tugab majburiy o'ldirish).

questions.question: Ssenariy: pod `Exit Code 143` bilan tugadi. Nima bo'ldi?
questions.explanation: Container SIGTERM (128 + 15) oldi — rolling update, node drain yoki scale-down paytida — va grace period ichida toza chiqdi. Odatda normal holat.

questions.question: Ssenariy: pod `ImagePullBackOff` / `ErrImagePull` da. Tipik sabablar?
questions.explanation: Image tag yoki repo URL'da xato.

questions.question: Ssenariy: pod `Pending` da. Sababini qanday aniqlaysiz?
questions.explanation: kubectl describe pod <name> → Events:

questions.question: Ssenariy: pod soatlab `Terminating` da qolib ketdi. Qanday xavfsiz hal qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Bloklovchi finalizer'larni tekshirish: kubectl get pod <name> -o jsonpath='{.metadata.finalizers}'.

questions.question: Ssenariy: Kubernetes'dagi `ndots:5` DNS muammosi va latency bo'ronlarini tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: Pod'dagi /etc/resolv.conf default options ndots:5.

questions.question: Ssenariy: yuqori trafikli HTTP servislar uchun rolling update'da zero-downtime'ga qanday erishasiz?
questions.explanation: preStop sleep: endpoint/ingress yangilanishi 1-3 s oladi — preStop (sleep 5) bilan eski pod shu vaqt ichida request'larga xizmat qiladi.

questions.question: Istio service mesh va uning asosiy komponentlari qanday?
questions.explanation: Trafik boshqaruvi, zero-trust xavfsizlik (mTLS) va observability beruvchi ochiq service mesh:

questions.question: Istio Ambient Mesh nima?
questions.explanation: Sidecar'siz arxitektura:

questions.question: Linkerd nima va Istio bilan solishtirganda?
questions.explanation: Rust'da yozilgan micro-proxy (data plane) va Go control plane'li yengil, juda past latency'li service mesh — Envoy asosidagi mesh'larga nisbatan sodda va kam resurs.

questions.question: Cilium Service Mesh nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel eBPF bilan L7 routing, mTLS va observability'ni boshqaradigan sidecar'siz mesh — L4 trafik uchun userspace proxy hop'lari yo'q (L7 uchun node bo'yicha Envoy).

questions.question: Cilium Hubble nima?
questions.explanation: Cilium va eBPF ustidagi observability: real vaqt servis bog'liqlik grafi, tarmoq flow log'lari, HTTP/DNS latency metrikalari.

questions.question: Cilium Cluster Mesh nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta mustaqil klasterni tarmoq darajasida ulaydi: klasterlararo pod routing, global servis discovery va failover.

questions.question: Control plane high availability qanday quriladi?
questions.explanation: Kamida 3 ta control plane node'ni mustaqil AZ'larda ishlatish, HA etcd quorum'i va API serverlar oldida tashqi L4 load balancer (NLB).

questions.question: etcd split-brain nima va qanday oldi olinadi?
questions.explanation: Tarmoq bo'linishi etcd node'larini ikki guruhga ajratib, ikkalasida leader paydo bo'lishi (Raft buni oldini oladi). Toq sonli node (3 yoki 5) va qat'iy majority quorum (⌊N/2⌋ + 1) — faqat majority tomoni yoza oladi.

questions.question: etcd snapshot va restore qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Snapshot: etcdctl snapshot save /backup/etcd-snapshot.db

questions.question: API Priority and Fairness (APF) nima?
questions.explanation: API Server'ni request toshqinidan himoya qiladi: so'rovlarni priority level va flow schema'larga ajratib, muhim bo'lmaganlarni navbatga qo'yadi yoki tashlaydi — kritik control loop'lar ishlashda davom etadi.

questions.question: Kubelet sertifikat rotatsiyasi nima?
questions.explanation: Kubelet API Server'ga autentifikatsiya uchun ishlatadigan client/server TLS sertifikatlarini muddati tugashidan oldin CSR orqali avtomatik yangilash.

questions.question: Custom kubelet konfiguratsiyasi (`kubelet-config.yaml`) nima?
questions.explanation: Resurs rezervlari (systemReserved, kubeReserved), container log hajmi va eviction chegaralarini boshqaradigan deklarativ fayl.

questions.question: System va Kube resurs rezervlari nima?
questions.explanation: system-reserved: OS daemon'lari (systemd, sshd) uchun CPU/RAM.

questions.question: Topology spread constraint va pod anti-affinity farqi.
questions.explanation: Anti-affinity — binar (bir node'ga tushadi yoki tushmaydi); topology spread — zonalar bo'ylab proporsional taqsimotni sozlash (maxSkew: 1) va ko'p replikada yaxshiroq scale.

questions.question: VolumeSnapshot (CSI snapshotter) nima?
questions.explanation: CSI driver orqali persistent volume'ning point-in-time snapshot'ini yaratuvchi CRD (VolumeSnapshot).

questions.question: Kubernetes'da volume expansion nima?
questions.explanation: StorageClass'da allowVolumeExpansion: true bo'lsa, PVC hajmini (spec.resources.requests.storage: 100Gi) oshirish. Kamaytirib bo'lmaydi.

questions.question: Generic ephemeral volume nima?
questions.explanation: Dinamik provisioner orqali pod uchun alohida vaqtinchalik disk yaratadi va pod tugashi bilan o'chiradi.

questions.question: Secret'larni at-rest shifrlash qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: API Server'da KMS provayderi (AWS KMS, Vault) bilan EncryptionConfiguration — Secret etcd'ga yozilishidan oldin shifrlanadi. Mavjud secret'larni qayta yozib shifrlash kerak.

questions.question: Kubernetes audit logging nima?
questions.explanation: API Server'ga har so'rovni (kim, nima, qachon, qaysi IP'dan, ruxsat berildimi) yozadigan xronologik xavfsizlik yozuvlari; audit policy bilan daraja sozlanadi.

questions.question: `kube-bench` nima?
questions.explanation: Klasterni CIS Kubernetes Benchmark bo'yicha xavfsiz sozlanganini tekshiradigan ochiq tool.

questions.question: `kube-hunter` nima?
questions.explanation: Jonli klasterda zaiflik va ochiq portlarni qidiradigan ochiq penetration testing tool (hozir aktiv rivojlanmaydi).

questions.question: `hostPath` mount orqali container escape qanday sodir bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: Host root fayl tizimini (hostPath: /) mount qilish hujumchiga /etc/shadow ni o'zgartirish, host cron'iga backdoor qo'yish yoki namespace'dan chiqish imkonini beradi. PSA restricted/baseline hostPath'ni taqiqlaydi.

questions.question: Docker socket mount orqali container escape qanday sodir bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: /var/run/docker.sock mount qilingan container host daemon'iga buyruq berib, host root huquqli privileged "qo'shni" container ochishi mumkin — amalda host'ga to'liq kirish.

questions.question: Workload identity federation (AWS IRSA / GCP Workload Identity / Azure) nima?
questions.explanation: Pod'ga OIDC bilan imzolangan ServiceAccount token projected qilinadi; pod uni cloud STS'da qisqa muddatli IAM credential'ga almashtiradi — statik access key kerak emas.

questions.question: EKS Pod Identity nima?
questions.explanation: EKS'ning agent asosidagi yangi mexanizmi: ServiceAccount'ni IAM role'ga bevosita bog'laydi, OIDC provider trust sozlamalari kerak emas (ko'p klasterda soddaroq).

questions.question: Kubernetes'da Crossplane nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes'ni universal control plane'ga aylantiradigan framework: cloud infra (S3, RDS) nativ CRD'lar orqali boshqariladi va doimiy reconcile qilinadi.

questions.question: `vcluster` nima?
questions.explanation: Host klaster namespace'i ichida to'liq izolyatsiyalangan virtual control plane — alohida API server va CRD'lar bilan multi-tenancy.

questions.question: Cluster API (CAPI) nima?
questions.explanation: Deklarativ API bilan AWS, Azure, GCP, vSphere'da ko'plab Kubernetes klasterlarini yaratish, upgrade va boshqarishni avtomatlashtiruvchi sub-loyiha.

questions.question: CoreDNS plugin arxitekturasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Corefile da sozlanadigan modulli plugin'lar (kubernetes, forward, cache, errors, health) DNS so'rovi qanday qayta ishlanishini belgilaydi.

questions.question: CoreDNS autoscaling qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: cluster-proportional-autoscaler bilan node va core soniga proporsional CoreDNS replikalari soni dinamik oshiriladi.

questions.question: Ingress pathType'lari (`Exact`, `Prefix`, `ImplementationSpecific`) qanday?
questions.explanation: Exact: yo'l aynan mos (/api/v1), katta-kichik harf farqlanadi.

questions.question: Envoy filter chain nima?
questions.explanation: Har ulanish uchun ketma-ket bajariladigan bosqichlar (TLS Inspector, HTTP Connection Manager, rate limit, RBAC, router).

questions.question: OPA Gatekeeper mutation nima?
questions.explanation: Yuborilgan manifest'larga kerakli metadata'ni (label, annotation, resource request) avtomatik qo'shish.

questions.question: Kyverno pod policy'larini auto-generation qilish nima?
questions.explanation: Pod'ga yozilgan qoida avtomatik ravishda yuqori controller'lar (Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job) uchun ham generatsiya qilinadi — xato erta, controller darajasida ushlanadi.

questions.question: Telepresence nima?
questions.explanation: Lokal dev process'ni masofaviy klaster tarmog'iga ulaydi va klaster trafigini lokal kodga proksilaydi.

questions.question: Skaffold nima?
questions.explanation: Lokal yoki masofaviy klasterga uzluksiz build, push, deploy siklini avtomatlashtiradigan Google CLI'si.

questions.question: Tilt nima?
questions.explanation: Fayl o'zgarishlarini kuzatib, ishlab turgan pod'larga tez sync qiladigan lokal dev muhit tool'i.

questions.question: Kind nima?
questions.explanation: Har node Docker container bo'lgan lokal ko'p node'li klaster — CI testlarda keng ishlatiladi.

questions.question: K3s nima?
questions.explanation: Bitta ~100MB'dan kichik binary'dagi yengil sertifikatlangan Kubernetes; default'da etcd o'rniga SQLite (edge va IoT uchun).

questions.question: MicroK8s nima?
questions.explanation: Snap sifatida paketlangan yengil upstream Kubernetes — dev workstation va edge uchun.

questions.question: Minikube nima?
questions.explanation: O'rganish va lokal test uchun VM yoki container ichida bitta node'li Kubernetes.

questions.question: API deprecation lifecycle qanday?
questions.explanation: API v1alpha1 → v1beta1 → v1 ga o'tadi; olib tashlanishidan oldin javoblarda deprecation ogohlantirishi beriladi.

questions.question: `krew` nima?
questions.explanation: kubectl uchun rasmiy plugin menejeri (kubectl ctx, kubectl ns, kubectl neat).

questions.question: `k9s` nima?
questions.explanation: Klaster resurslarini real vaqtda kuzatish, boshqarish va debug qilish uchun terminal UI.

questions.question: `kubecolor` nima?
questions.explanation: kubectl output'ini rangli qiladigan wrapper.

questions.question: Karpenter node expiration nima?
questions.explanation: Node'larni belgilangan muddatdan keyin (masalan 30 kun; yangi API'da expireAfter) avtomatik almashtirish — OS patch'larini majburlash uchun.

questions.question: Karpenter disruption budgets nima?
questions.explanation: Ixtiyoriy optimallashtirishda bir vaqtda nechta node o'chirilishi/consolidate qilinishini cheklovchi siyosat.

questions.question: Dual-stack networking nima?
questions.explanation: Pod va Service'larga bir vaqtda IPv4 va IPv6 manzil berish.

questions.question: MetalLB nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud LoadBalancer integratsiyasi bo'lmagan bare-metal klasterlar uchun LoadBalancer Service implementatsiyasi (L2/ARP yoki BGP).

questions.question: Cilium BGP control plane nima?
questions.explanation: Cilium pod va Service CIDR'larini data center ToR router'lariga BGP orqali e'lon qiladi.

questions.question: CSI volume cloning nima?
questions.explanation: Mavjud PVC ma'lumotining aynan nusxasi bilan yangi PV yaratish (bir xil storage'da).

questions.question: CSI ephemeral inline volume nima?
questions.explanation: Alohida PVC'siz spec.volumes ichida bevosita vaqtinchalik storage ulash.

questions.question: Ssenariy: yangi versiya deploy qilindi va CPU 100% ga chiqib pod'lar yiqilyapti. Qanday triage qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Avval zararni to'xtatish: kubectl rollout undo deployment/<name>.

questions.question: Ssenariy: CoreDNS pod'lari `OOMKilled` bo'lyapti. Qanday tiklaysiz va butunlay tuzatasiz?
questions.explanation: CoreDNS memory limit'ini oshirish.

questions.question: Ssenariy: worker node'larda `/var/lib/containerd` diski vaqti-vaqti bilan to'lib qolyapti. Qanday hal qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Ishlatilmayotgan image'larni tozalash: crictl rmi --prune.

questions.question: Ssenariy: dasturchi tasodifan prod namespace'ni o'chirdi. Kubernetes qanday ishlaydi va buning oldini qanday olasiz?
questions.explanation: Xulq: namespace ichidagi barcha resurslar (Pod, Service, PVC, Secret) cascading o'chiriladi; reclaimPolicy Delete bo'lsa disklar ham ketadi.

questions.question: Ssenariy: pod'lar orasidagi aloqa turli node'larda ishlamaydi, bitta node'da ishlaydi. Root cause nima?
questions.explanation: Security group / firewall: node'lararo encapsulation trafigi (VXLAN 8472, Geneve 6081) bloklangan.

questions.question: Ssenariy: API Server HTTP 429 Too Many Requests qaytaryapti. Qanday triage qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Prometheus'da APF metrikalari (apiserver_flow_control_rejected_requests_total).

questions.question: Ssenariy: etcd disk yozish latency'si 10ms dan oshsa nima bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: Leader heartbeat'lari timeout bo'ladi, tez-tez leader election, API so'rovlari osiladi, kubelet status yangilay olmaydi. Maxsus yuqori IOPS'li NVMe va etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds monitoringi kerak.

questions.question: Ssenariy: 1000 workload'ni Ingress'dan Gateway API'ga zero-downtime qanday ko'chirasiz?
questions.explanation: Gateway API CRD'lari va controller (Envoy Gateway / Cilium).

questions.question: Ssenariy: pod log'i bo'sh va process darhol tugaydi. Qanday troubleshoot qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Interaktiv override: kubectl run debug --image=<image> -it -- /bin/sh (yoki kubectl debug --copy-to).

questions.question: Ssenariy: klasterdagi barcha TLS sertifikatlarni qanday xavfsiz rotatsiya qilasiz (kubeadm)?
questions.explanation: kubeadm certs check-expiration.

questions.question: Node Problem Detector (NPD) nima?
questions.explanation: Node muammolarini (kernel deadlock, buzilgan fayl tizimi, hardware xato) kuzatib, API Server'ga Node Condition sifatida xabar beradigan DaemonSet.

questions.question: Kube-Janitor nima?
questions.explanation: TTL annotation (janitor/ttl: 7d) bo'yicha eskirgan yoki prod bo'lmagan resurslarni avtomatik o'chiradigan controller.

questions.question: Popeye nima?
questions.explanation: Jonli klasterni skanerlab misconfiguration, o'lik resurslar va ortiqcha request'larni ko'rsatadigan CLI.

questions.question: Reloader nima?
questions.explanation: ConfigMap va Secret'larni kuzatib, ular o'zgarganda bog'liq Deployment'larni rolling restart qiladigan controller.

questions.question: Goldilocks nima?
questions.explanation: VPA'ni recommendation rejimida ishlatib optimal CPU/xotira request/limit tavsiyalarini ko'rsatadigan utilita.

questions.question: Kubernetes Descheduler nima?
questions.explanation: Scheduling mezonlariga endi mos kelmaydigan pod'larni (kam yuklangan node, buzilgan affinity) evict qilib, scheduler'ga qayta muvozanatlash imkonini beradigan optimizer.

questions.question: Chaos Mesh nima?
questions.explanation: CRD'lar orqali pod o'ldirish, latency qo'shish, I/O buzish kabi nosozliklar kiritadigan Kubernetes chaos platformasi.

questions.question: kube-state-metrics (KSM) nima?
questions.explanation: API Server'ni tinglab obyektlar holati (deployment replikalari, pod phase, limit'lar) haqida Prometheus metrikalari chiqaradigan add-on.

questions.question: Oddiy pod tarmog'i va `hostNetwork: true` farqi.
questions.explanation: Oddiy pod CNI'dan izolyatsiyalangan IP oladi; hostNetwork: true pod host tarmoq interfeysiga bevosita bog'lanadi (port konfliktlari va xavfsizlik xavfi).

questions.question: RuntimeClass nima?
questions.explanation: Bir klasterda turli pod'larga turli runtime berish (oddiylari runc, ishonchsizlari gVisor/kata).

questions.question: Pod'larda sysctl nima?
questions.explanation: spec.securityContext.sysctls orqali pod namespace'i uchun kernel parametrlari (net.core.somaxconn=1024); "unsafe" sysctl'lar kubelet'da ruxsat talab qiladi.

questions.question: Volume binding mode (`Immediate` va `WaitForFirstConsumer`) farqi.
questions.explanation: Immediate: PVC yaratilishi bilan PV provision qilinadi (AZ mos kelmasligi mumkin).

questions.question: Storage topology awareness nima?
questions.explanation: CSI driver block volume'ni schedule qilingan node bilan bir xil AZ'da ajratishini ta'minlash (EBS boshqa AZ'ga ulanmaydi).

questions.question: Ephemeral storage requests/limits nima?
questions.explanation: Container writable layer va emptyDir uchun request/limit (ephemeral-storage: 2Gi) — pod node root diskini to'ldirmasligi uchun (oshsa evict).

questions.question: Secrets Store CSI Driver (Kubernetes kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, Vault'dagi secret'larni etcd'da saqlamasdan pod fayl tizimiga in-memory fayl sifatida mount qiladi.

questions.question: CRD conversion webhook nima?
questions.explanation: Custom Resource'larni turli sxema versiyalari orasida (v1alpha1 → v1) o'qish/yozish paytida avtomatik konvertatsiya qiluvchi webhook.

questions.question: Go SDK'da dynamic client va typed client farqi.
questions.explanation: Typed (clientset): compile qilingan statik Go struct'lar bilan.

questions.question: Informer / SharedInformer nima?
questions.explanation: API Server obyektlarining lokal xotiradagi cache'i: watch event'lari bilan yangilanadi va OnAdd, OnUpdate, OnDelete handler'larini polling'siz chaqiradi; SharedInformer bitta watch'ni ko'p controller'ga ulashadi.

questions.question: Controller'da workqueue nima?
questions.explanation: Reconcile so'rovlarini buferlaydigan, bir key bo'yicha takroriy yangilanishlarni dedup qiladigan, rate-limited thread-safe navbat.

questions.question: Reconcile loop nima?
questions.explanation: Idempotent funksiya: Reconcile(Request) -> (Result, error) — joriy holatni desired state bilan solishtirib, ularni moslash uchun CRUD bajaradi; xatoda qayta navbatga qo'yiladi.

questions.question: Optimistic concurrency control (`resourceVersion`) nima?
questions.explanation: Har obyektning resourceVersion i bor; update'da client versiyasi etcd'dagi joriy versiyaga mos kelmasa, API Server rad etadi (HTTP 409 Conflict) — client qayta o'qib urinadi.

questions.question: Control loop'larda eventual consistency nima?
questions.explanation: Controller'lar darhol sinxronlashni kutmaydi; yiqilgan operatsiyalarni tizim desired holatga kelguncha qayta-qayta urinadi.

questions.question: Subresource (`/status`, `/scale`) nima?
questions.explanation: Obyektning aniq qismini yangilash uchun alohida endpoint'lar (masalan /status yangilash spec'ni o'zgartirmaydi va generation ni oshirmaydi; RBAC alohida beriladi).

questions.question: OwnerReferences va BlockOwnerDeletion nima?
questions.explanation: Child obyektni parent controller'ga bog'lovchi metadata — parent o'chirilganda GC child'larni o'chiradi; blockOwnerDeletion foreground o'chirishda child'lar ketmaguncha parent'ni ushlab turadi.

questions.question: Headless Service SRV yozuvi nima?
questions.explanation: CoreDNS headless servis ortidagi pod'larning har nomlangan porti uchun port raqami va hostname bo'lgan SRV yozuvlarini qaytaradi.

questions.question: Service session affinity (`ClientIP`) nima?
questions.explanation: Bir client IP'dan kelgan so'rovlarni belgilangan vaqt davomida (timeoutSeconds) bir xil pod'ga yo'naltirish.

questions.question: `externalTrafficPolicy` (`Cluster` va `Local`) farqi.
questions.explanation: Cluster (default): trafik olgan node SNAT qilib istalgan node'dagi pod'ga yuboradi (qo'shimcha hop, client IP yo'qoladi).

questions.question: Traffic distribution (`PreferClose`) nima?
questions.explanation: Service trafigini chaqiruvchiga topologik yaqin endpoint'larga (bir zona) yo'naltirish — cross-AZ xarajat va latency kamayadi.

questions.question: Kubernetes IPAM nima?
questions.explanation: CNI ichida node va pod'lar uchun IP bloklarini ajratish va kuzatish quyi tizimi.

questions.question: AWS VPC CNI prefix delegation nima?
questions.explanation: Har ENI'ga alohida secondary IP o'rniga /28 prefiks (16 IP) ajratish — EC2'dagi maksimal pod soni bir necha baravar oshadi.

questions.question: Azure CNI va Kubenet farqi.
questions.explanation: Azure CNI: har pod VNet'dan haqiqiy IP oladi (tez, lekin VNet CIDR'ini ko'p sarflaydi; Overlay rejimi buni yengillashtiradi).

questions.question: Calico eBPF data plane nima?
questions.explanation: iptables o'rniga yuqori unumdor eBPF dasturlari: kube-proxy'ni almashtiradi, WireGuard shifrlash va scale qiladigan NetworkPolicy.

questions.question: Cilium transparent encryption (WireGuard) nima?
questions.explanation: Barcha node-node va pod-pod trafigini kernel WireGuard bilan sidecar'siz avtomatik shifrlash.

questions.question: Node autoscaling'da overprovisioning nima?
questions.explanation: Past PriorityClass li "pause" pod'lar zaxira sig'imni band qilib turadi. Haqiqiy pod kelganda ularni preempt qilib darhol joylashadi, node esa fonda qo'shiladi — scale-up kechikishi yashiriladi.

questions.question: Karpenter'da mixed instance policy nima?
questions.explanation: Spot va On-Demand pool'lari bo'ylab turli EC2 turlari, o'lchamlari va avlodlarini dinamik aralashtirish — availability maksimal, xarajat minimal.

questions.question: Multi-Cluster Services (MCS API) nima?
questions.explanation: ServiceExport va ServiceImport bilan A klasterdagi servisni B klasterdan my-svc.my-ns.svc.clusterset.local orqali topish va chaqirish standarti.

questions.question: Submariner nima?
questions.explanation: Turli cloud va data center'lardagi klaster pod'lari orasida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri IPsec/WireGuard tunnel yaratuvchi ochiq tool.

questions.question: Kyverno Sigstore bilan image imzosini qanday tekshiradi?
questions.explanation: Admission qoidasi pod schedule'dan oldin image imzosini (Cosign, Rekor transparency log bilan) tekshiradi va imzosizlarni rad etadi.

questions.question: Falco eBPF syscall monitoringi nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel syscall'larini (execve, openat, socket) ushlab, container ichidagi anomal xulqni (shell ochish, privilege escalation) aniqlaydigan CNCF tool.

questions.question: Kubernetes hard multi-tenancy arxitekturasi qanday?
questions.explanation: vcluster (izolyatsiyalangan control plane), Cilium NetworkPolicy (L3-L7 izolyatsiya), gVisor/Kata (sandbox kernel runtime) va ResourceQuota — ishonchsiz tenant'larni umumiy fizik klasterda xavfsiz ishlatish uchun. Eng...
